content: Kusanguka ca Yesu
Kaha omo sapalalo yahitile, Maliya Mandalena, na Maliya vaina ya Tiango, na Salome, kaha valandele nkundu linga vakavuavese Yesu.
Kaha omo capuile cimene mene ca litangua liakulivanga ha calumingu vaile ku cihilo omo litangua liatuhukile.
Kaha vahandekele kuli umo na mukuavo nguavo, “Iya honi akasa kukatuhumisila lije livue liakulema lije lili ku cikolo ca cihilo?”
Kaha vatalele kuilu, vamuene lije livue valihumisako, liapuile liakama.
Kaha vakovelele mu cihilo, kaha vamuene yala natumama ku cilio, nazala kazaku ka kutoka kalaha, kaha valikomokelele.
Kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguavo, “Keti muli komokele, mulinakutonda Yesu ua Nazaleta, uje vashukikile. Nasanguka, uahimo, mu cihela muvamutsindile.
Vuno honi yeni, mukaleke vandongisi vendi na Petulu ngueni alivanga kulutue lueni ku Ngalileya, kuje mu kamumona, nge omo muamilekelele.”
Kaha vahuminemo nakuteua, nakujaja nakulikomokela, kaha na cimo cahi civahandekele kuli muntu uoshe, omuo vovuile liova.
Yesu Alisholola kuli Maliya Mandalena
Honi omo Yesu uasangukile ha litangua liakulivanga cimene ca calumingu, ualisholuele ha kulivanga kuli Maliya Mandalena, uje yahumisile mahamba vatanu na vavali.
Kaha uaile nakuleka vaje vakele navo, vakele na vusiua na kulila.
Vuno honi cipue omo vovuile nguavo hali nakuyoya kaha na ikeye uamumuene, vuno honi kuvamutsilielele.
Yesu Alisholola kuli vamo Vandongisi vendi vavali
Hanima yeci ualisholuele mucifua ceka naua kuli vamo vantu vavali, omo vakele nakuenda muli lifuti.
Kaha vahilukile nakuleka voshe, vuno honi kuvavatsilielele.
Yesu Alisholola kuli vaje Likumi Naumo

Hanima yevi Yesu ualisholuele kuli vandongisi vendi likumi na umo omo vatumanene ku mesa, kaha uavatenukilile omuo hakuhona lutsilielo na kukola ca mitima yavo, omuo kuvatsilielele vaje vamumuene te nasanguka.
Kaha uahandekele kuli vakevo nguendi, “Yeni mu lifuti lioshe nakuambulula muzimbu uacili kuli muntu voshe.
Uoshe uje atsiliela nakumumbuitika akovoka, vuno honi uje katsiliela vakamuhisa.
Kaha vitantekeyeso vikakala na vaje vakatsiliela mu lizina liange, vakahumisa mahamba kaha vakahandeka na mu vindaka vieka,
vakakuata manoka, kaha cipue vakanua cuma ca kutsiha ku cikavavulumuna, vakasaleka mavoko avo hali vaka kuvavala, kaha vakakanguka.”
Yesu Vamutuala Muilu
Kaha hanima yakuhandeka navo, Muene Yesu vamutualele muilu, nakutumama ku livoko lia cilio lia Njambi.
Kaha vaile nakuambulula kuoshe, kaha Muene uapangele navo nakushulisa mezi a vitantekeyeso vije vivalingile. Ameni.
